map.按 GB 5009.33，标准曲线 c=(A−截距)/斜率（A 为吸光度）；结合: Per GB 5009.33, the standard curve is c = (A - intercept)/slope (A is absorbance); combine it with the sampling and test volumes to convert the nitrite content of the sample.
